description: This file contains matcher functions for Playwright testing framework, including assertions for element states, attributes, text content, URL, and response status, with external dependencies on Playwright core utilities and internal test utilities.

classes.name: LocatorEx
classes.description: Extended Locator interface with _expect method for assertions.

classes.name: FrameEx
classes.description: Extended Frame interface with _expect method for assertions.

classes.name: APIResponseEx
classes.description: Extended APIResponse with _fetchLog method for logging response.

methods.name: toBeAttached
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is attached or detached.

methods.name: toBeChecked
methods.description: Asserts the checked or indeterminate state of a locator.

methods.name: toBeDisabled
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is disabled.

methods.name: toBeEditable
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is editable or read-only.

methods.name: toBeEmpty
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is empty.

methods.name: toBeEnabled
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is enabled.

methods.name: toBeFocused
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is focused.

methods.name: toBeHidden
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is hidden.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is visible.

methods.name: toBeInViewport
methods.description: Asserts whether a locator is in the viewport.

methods.name: toContainText
methods.description: Asserts that a locator contains specified text or pattern.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleDescription
methods.description: Asserts accessible description of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleName
methods.description: Asserts accessible name of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleErrorMessage
methods.description: Asserts accessible error message of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAttribute
methods.description: Asserts attribute presence or value.

methods.name: toHaveClass
methods.description: Asserts class attribute contains expected classes.

methods.name: toContainClass
methods.description: Asserts locator contains specified class(es).

methods.name: toHaveCount
methods.description: Asserts element count.

methods.name: toHaveCSS
methods.description: Asserts CSS property value.

methods.name: toHaveId
methods.description: Asserts element ID.

methods.name: toHaveJSProperty
methods.description: Asserts JavaScript property value.

methods.name: toHaveRole
methods.description: Asserts ARIA role.

methods.name: toHaveText
methods.description: Asserts element text content.

methods.name: toHaveValue
methods.description: Asserts element value.

methods.name: toHaveValues
methods.description: Asserts multiple element values.

methods.name: toHaveTitle
methods.description: Asserts page title.

methods.name: toHaveURL
methods.description: Asserts page URL.

methods.name: toBeOK
methods.description: Asserts API response status is OK.

methods.name: toPass
methods.description: Polls until callback passes or times out.
